scope: Bounded local operator composition of existing dataset, training and inference artifact owners
input: Explicit regular UTF-8 local files, operator-supplied rights references, classification, immutable run ID and bounded model/configuration/resource policy
admission: The existing TrainingRepository database receives an additive governed_cli_request table. Its canonical request binds source paths and observed byte digests, rights, configuration, code/environment digests, initial dataset CAS version and the original operator acquisition timestamp before any ingestion or training work. Same request returns the original timestamp/version; changed request under the same run ID rejects. Reused source bytes retain their original immutable acquired_at and require unchanged source metadata.
dataset: DatasetRegistry.ingest_materialized computes dataset splits and quality from original bytes. Only DatasetRegistry.training_corpus supplies model input; digest-only legacy dataset APIs cannot provide CLI content.
training: Reference, neural, fixed data-parallel, elastic physical-process restart, or actual recurrent DPO preference training executes under the existing TrainingRepository. Elastic runs preserve immutable logical ranks while a bounded execution-only physical worker count may change at restart. Preference runs require canonical chosen/rejected JSON, a completed governed neural parent and explicit planned evaluation suite identity. All variants retain cumulative usage, exact source authority and complete learned checkpoints.
artifact: Existing write_local_model_artifact atomically emits content-addressed reloadable model JSON after training has completed. The receipt binds dataset/quality/source sequence, immutable run, checkpoint and serialized model artifact without printing training text.
failures: Reject symlinks, nonregular files, duplicate paths/inodes, empty or invalid UTF-8 content and inputs exceeding byte bounds before dataset writes
Reject input/output/database aliasing before overwriting an operator input or authoritative database
Reject changed content, rights, model configuration, code, environment or budget under an admitted run identity
Dataset rights revocation, deletion or quality drift blocks continuation and completed retry publication
Interrupted artifact publication retries from completed checkpoint without replaying model training

Nonparallel algorithms reject process-count or collective-timeout overrides; fixed data_parallel binds membership and deadline, elastic binds logical ranks and maximum physical allocation but permits a new physical count at fenced restart
Elastic physical_workers is execution-only and bounded by immutable max_processes; completed retry returns its recorded roster rather than rewriting evidence from the new requested count
Preference operator requests bind parent checkpoint/model lineage, beta and planned evaluation suite; changed or withdrawn parent/source authority blocks updates and artifact publication
rollback: Remove the CLI entrypoint to stop new admission while retaining DatasetRegistry and TrainingRepository authorities; delete only derived output artifacts, never regenerate revoked training content
